description:
Full **ticket-policy** epic fixture (published-cutover proof). Scope policy is a sibling over the **4.2 harness**, not a branch in this script.

## Background

Script the parent (deterministic fake completions). No paid LLM.

## Scenario (ticket policy only)

1. Epic with two parallel tickets and one dependent.
2. `/bw run` inject, one open group.
3. Two implementation children on shared branch.
4. Overlap notice fires; execution **continues** (no pause, no worktree).
5. One live child → parent question (`parentMessage`); parent answers via `send_minion_message`; child continues; then **one** settle (mail/settle single winner).
6. Settlement does not close.
7. Reviewer is **not** started while that ticket’s implementer is still live.
8. Review child on one clean ticket and one with findings; scripted parent: **fix** (re-review required), **file** (durable nonblocking follow-up issue), **reject** (rationale recorded).
9. Consequential decisions appear in the parent recap and/or ordinary `bw comment`.
10. Dependent unlocks only after parent closed the blocker ticket (`bw ready`), never because a child settled.
11. Epic close exits run; halt continuation forgets group.
12. No tmux, no automatic worktree, no landing/registry/worker tools.

## Success criteria

- tmux binary not required.
- Packet coalescing if two completions are near-simultaneous.
- Quality commands run as implementer/reviewer actions, not a beadwork runner.

## Test plan / logging

Structured logs: timestamp, step, policy=ticket, issue ids, child ids, group id, event class, packet seq, bw status.

Failure bundle (harness): last packets, fleet, `bw ready`, `bw show` epic, active tools, PATH tmux probe.

## Considerations

Share 4.2’s scripted-parent helper. Separate scenario file from 4.6 so the two e2es can proceed in parallel.

comments.text: Published-cutover proof. Script parent turns. Separate ticket-policy fixture; do not mix scope policy into the same ambiguous test.
Peer message, parentMessage, and mail/settle are required in this fixture, not optional.

title: Prove one epic end-to-end with ticket review and no tmux
